sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price, lo.strategy,
         split_part(lo.market_ticker, '-', 1) series
  from live_orders lo
  where lo.strategy in ('mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b','Lmmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10')
    and lo.action = 'buy' and lo.side = 'no' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null and lo.limit_price is not null
    and lo.created_at >= '2026-07-26T00:00:00Z' and lo.created_at < '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'
), f as (
  select kalshi_order_id, min(coalesce((raw_fill_json->>'created_time')::timestamptz, filled_at)) ft
  from fills group by 1
), s as (
  select market_ticker,
         max(case when side = 'no' then resolved_value else 100 - resolved_value end) settle_no
  from paper_trades where resolved_value is not null and strategy like '%mmsell%' group by 1
), sp as (
  select o.id, (select ct.yes_ask - ct.yes_bid from mmsell_candidate_ticks ct
                 where ct.market_ticker = o.market_ticker
                   and ct.captured_at between o.created_at - interval '10 minutes' and o.created_at + interval '1 minute'
                 order by ct.captured_at desc limit 1) spread
  from o
), x as (
  select o.*, (f.ft is not null) filled, extract(epoch from f.ft - o.created_at) / 60.0 fmin,
         (s.settle_no - o.limit_price) c, sp.spread
  from o left join f using (kalshi_order_id) join s using (market_ticker) join sp on sp.id = o.id
), y as (
  select x.*, d.dim, d.bucket from x cross join lateral (values
    ('all', 'all'),
    ('book', strategy),
    ('fillmin', case when not filled then 'unfilled' when fmin < 1 then 'a <1m' when fmin < 10 then 'b 1-10m'
                     when fmin < 60 then 'c 10-60m' else 'd 60m+' end),
    ('spread', case when spread is null then '?' when spread <= 1 then '<=1' when spread = 2 then '2' else '3+' end),
    ('spread_x_fast', case when spread is null then '?' when spread <= 1 then '<=1' else '2+' end || ' / ' ||
                      case when not filled then 'unfilled' when fmin < 10 then 'fast' else 'slow' end)
  ) d(dim, bucket)
)
select dim, bucket, count(*) n, sum(case when filled then 1 else 0 end) nf,
       round((avg(c) filter (where filled))::numeric, 2) fill_c,
       round((avg(c) filter (where not filled))::numeric, 2) unfill_c,
       round((avg(case when c < 0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) filter (where filled))::numeric, 3) fill_loss,
       count(distinct (case when filled then date_trunc('day', created_at) end)) fill_days
from y group by dim, bucket order by dim, bucket
